checks.explanation: Confirmed: Eli Lilly's oral GLP-1 pill orforglipron (approved as Foundayo) launched in 2026, matching the 'next year' prediction made from this September 2025 episode.
GLP-1 prices have been trending down (e.g., new sub-$150/month price points), but no independent source confirms a precise sustained ~5%-per-year decline rate.
The predicted 2030s patent-cliff window for Mounjaro hasn't arrived.

Eli Lilly announced multiple new US manufacturing plants in the months following this prediction, including a $6B Alabama facility and a $6.5B Houston, Texas facility, consistent with the pace of expansion predicted.

sources.title: Lilly plans to build a new $6.5 billion facility to manufacture active pharmaceutical ingredients in Texas

checks.explanation: Confirmed closely: Novo Nordisk's Evoke/Evoke+ Alzheimer's trials, reported in November 2025, failed to meet their primary clinical endpoints (not positive), while still showing a modest ~10% reduction in a key pathology biomarker (p-tau181), a 'right direction' signal too small to matter clinically, matching Ricks's specific guess almost exactly.

sources.title: Semaglutide fails to slow progression of Alzheimer's in highly anticipated trials
